description: Weight-window variance reduction for the nf-bnct-001 frozen benchmark: neutron and photon windows on the 40x40x40 scoring mesh, lower bounds derived from each particle's diagnostic fluence tally of a dedicated analog run (MAGIC-equivalent normalization).
provenance_note: MAGIC-style forward-flux derivation: per energy group the volume-normalized tally mean scaled by 1/(2 * group_max) becomes the lower bound; cells whose tally relative error exceeds 0.5 are disabled. Energy groups match the case's diagnostic fluence grids so no re-binning occurs.
